It must be explicitly labeled historical red snapshot, and its handoff recommendation aligned to the approved WU-16-before-WU-06 final strict regression. The seven revised design artifacts themselves pass ID/JSON checks and preserve this sequence.

WU-06 red-test attempt is incomplete and cannot be handed off: 11 shallow assertion failures against argument-free lifecycle shells are not meaningful crash-window evidence; TS-28 and TS-30 pass structurally only; missing required behavior coverage includes persisted before/after states and audits for TS-20..TS-26, TS-27a retries/escalation, TS-28 active worker race, TS-29 injected outage/recovery order, TS-30 behavioral bounds, TS-32 lock/startup barrier, TS-42 audit retention, TS-44b allocation audit, TS-56 truncated-inventory fail-closed, and TS-65 audit refusal. Repair required before reporting complete.

WU-06 red-test rework remains blocked. No meaningful red evidence was produced: the current lifecycle constructors have no injected stores/storage/lock/clock, and the ports lack the planned reconciliation enumeration, job epoch fencing, epoch advancement, and retention purge operations. The WU-06 test attempts remained no-op shell assertions; required TS-20..26 persisted crash-window before/after state, TS-27a durable retry/backoff, TS-28 active job protection, TS-29 outage recovery ordering, TS-30 behavioral bounds, TS-32 lock/startup ordering, TS-42 audit-preserving purge, TS-44b allocation audit, TS-56 truncated inventory fail-closed, and TS-65 audit refusal have no valid behavioral red tests. A design/interface pass is needed before this red stage can be completed; no tests or code were changed by the latest rework.

WU-06 design/interface clarification applied per review: JobStore owns job inventory and fencing; AllocationStore owns LEFT JOIN allocation recovery rows and atomic CAS-plus-audit updates; fence_job uses expected_epoch, expected_status and expected_state_version; cross-table retention purge is assigned to a separate coordinator/store rather than AllocationStore. The current red-tests rework remains blocked pending implementation-design review/update of the related interfaces and verification that the WU-06 test requirements and store ports are implemented; no red tests or evidence produced by this design-document change.

WU-06 remains blocked pending implementation-design alignment: the owner decision requires allocation.reconciled for each applied allocation-reconciliation CAS, and existing documents conflict with that decision. Rework IFC §7 event set/TS-44b, FD audit inventory/F-27, and WU-06 tests/work-units/plan to consistently preserve allocation.reconciled and the missing-file policy (success, MISSING_FILE, append every complete full scan, allocation row unchanged, in-memory report count only; no observed outcome). No WU-06 red tests or evidence produced until the design artifacts are reconciled.

WU-06 red-tests rework is blocked pending implementation-design review and cross-artifact alignment of allocation.reconciled in IFC §7, TS-44b and WU-06. The requested event/outcome semantics are being reconciled; no WU-06 red tests or evidence produced by this document alignment.

WU-06 attempt 13 produced partial store-seam red only: 2 new behavior assertions fail against no-op AllocationStore defaults, and the no-effect CAS test structurally passes. Existing PG15 reconciliation checks remain red on epoch/fence/deadline/allocation inventory seams. Lifecycle TS-20..TS-30, TS-32, TS-42, TS-44b, TS-56 and TS-65 are still not behaviorally covered; current Reconciler remains an argument-free shell and retention is absent. No lifecycle claims made.

WU-06 remains incomplete; do not hand off to build. The focused PG15 store tests compile and produce assertion failures against no-op defaults, but coverage is only JobStore epoch/list/fence/deadline seams and AllocationStore inventory/reconcile seams. The missing-file test fixture is invalid for the contract because it lacks an unexpired incomplete owner/correlation. The applied-CAS audit test does not prove transaction rollback on audit failure; audit assertions do not verify all required fields, and reconcile_state currently uses INTERRUPTED_RESTART rather than the designed RECONCILED reason. TS-20..26 lifecycle orchestration, TS-27a cleanup retries, TS-28 active-worker protection, TS-29 outage/recovery, TS-30 lifecycle boundaries, TS-32 lock/startup, TS-42 retention, TS-44b complete event set, TS-56 fail-closed truncation, TS-65 audit refusal remain uncovered. Current  event has no AuditEventKind source variant/adapter support; no production logic was added. Correct the invalid/store tests and provide meaningful lifecycle tests before completing red.

Correction: the allocation.reconciled audit event has no AuditEventKind source variant or adapter support; no production lifecycle behavior was added. The current WU-06 tests remain store-seam only and are not full lifecycle red evidence. The missing-file test fixture lacks the required unexpired incomplete owner/correlation; applied-CAS atomic rollback is not tested; audit field assertions are incomplete; reconcile_state uses INTERRUPTED_RESTART instead of the specified RECONCILED reason. TS-20..26 lifecycle orchestration, TS-27a cleanup retries, TS-28 active-worker protection, TS-29 outage/recovery, TS-30 lifecycle boundaries, TS-32 lock/startup, TS-42 retention, TS-44b full event set, TS-56 truncated inventory, and TS-65 refusal cases remain uncovered.

WU-06 focused PostgreSQL store-contract red suite is recorded, but lifecycle red handoff remains incomplete. Eight focused DB tests run: seven failed assertions against no-op defaults and one structural lost-CAS pass. JobStore epoch/fence/deadline seams and AllocationStore inventory/reconcile seams are partially exercised. The reconciliation audit rollback test stops at the no-op return before invoking its sink, so atomic rollback is unproven; the applied CAS fixture supplies InterruptedRestart instead of designed RECONCILED; and there is no AuditEventKind::AllocationReconciled or DB adapter override yet. No valid lifecycle behavior tests cover TS-20..26, TS-27a, TS-28/29/30/32, TS-42, full TS-44b, TS-56 fail-closed, or TS-65. WU-06 build stage must not start.

WU-06 remains blocked: the current run provides only partial PostgreSQL store-interface evidence, not lifecycle red coverage. Focused suite: 8 tests, 7 failed assertions and 1 structural lost-CAS pass. The applied allocation-CAS oracle still mismatches the design (fixture supplies InterruptedRestart but expects RECONCILED); the no-op default prevents audit rollback injection from being reached; and no AuditEventKind::AllocationReconciled or DB adapter override exists. Missing valid lifecycle red coverage: TS-20..26 crash windows, TS-27a cleanup retry/exhaustion, TS-28 active worker protection, TS-29 outage recovery ordering, TS-30 behavioral bounds, TS-32 lock/startup ordering, TS-42 retention purge, full TS-44b audit fields, TS-56 truncated inventory fail-closed, TS-65 audit refusal. WU-06 remains blocked: focused PostgreSQL store-seam suite is 8 tests, 7 failed assertions and 1 structural lost-CAS pass after correcting the invalid allocation-CAS fixture reason. No lifecycle red tests cover TS-20..TS-26, TS-27a, TS-28, TS-29, TS-30 lifecycle bounds, TS-32, TS-42, TS-44b allocation audit fields/coupling, TS-56 truncation fail-closed, or TS-65. Existing JobStore/AllocationStore default methods return no-op values and Db adapters have no overrides; the audit rollback case exits before invoking its sink. Do not hand off to build-and-verify.

WU-06 remains blocked. Current lifecycle integration is not implementable as meaningful red-only coverage against this baseline: Reconciler/Cleaner/Sweeper/Runtime are no-op shells without injected dependencies; JobStore and AllocationStore lifecycle methods have no-op default implementations and DbJobStore/DbAllocationStore do not override epoch, fencing, inventory, reconciliation CAS, missing-file audit, or deadline inventory; RetentionStore/DbRetentionStore do not exist. Existing attempt-18 artifacts explicitly disclose those gaps, and existing shell-based lifecycle tests are argument-free and assertion-only, not persisted-row/temp-filesystem tests. Implementing real behavior/adapters would violate this stage's no-lifecycle-behavior constraint; constructing authentic red behavioral tests requires the designated testable lifecycle wiring and adapter behavior not present. No new WU-06 behavior tests or stage artifacts are claimed. IDs check passes. Cargo test from workspace root was incorrectly invoked and failed to locate Cargo.toml; corrected manifest invocation ran and returned exit 101 with new lifecycle shell tests failing, but full output was truncated; no evidence artifact written from this run. No WU-06 completion claim.

Attempt 20 confirmed the WU-06 design/interface prerequisite is still unmet. Reconciler/Cleaner/Sweeper/Runtime remain no-op shells without injected lifecycle dependencies; JobStore/AllocationStore DB adapters do not implement the new epoch/fence/reconcile operations; RetentionStore and DB adapter are absent. Attempts keep reproducing store-seam reds and shell assertion failures, not valid TS-20..TS-65 lifecycle red evidence. Red-tests forbids implementing lifecycle behavior, so the missing adapters cannot be built here as a workaround. No new WU-06 lifecycle tests or artifacts from this attempt; do not hand off to build-and-verify.

The partial store-seam evidence remains incomplete. A supported design-rework route is required before this work can proceed.

TS-65 also lacks an assertion that the failure-injection audit sink was actually called, allowing unrelated errors to satisfy result.is_err.
